title: Velunox Technologies | Smart Industrial IoT
snippet: Velunox Technologies builds industrial IoT sensor networks and cloud monitoring dashboards for manufacturing plants worldwide.
content:
Velunox Technologies

We build industrial IoT sensor networks and cloud monitoring dashboards that help manufacturing plants cut downtime. Founded in 2016, Velunox now serves clients across 14 countries.

Explore our Services, read our latest news, or get in touch via Contact.

title: About Velunox Technologies
snippet: Learn about Velunox's mission, leadership team, and history since our founding in 2016.
content:
About Us

Velunox Technologies was founded in 2016 by a team of industrial engineers frustrated with unreliable factory sensors. Today we employ over 200 people across engineering, sales, and support.

Our headquarters is in Rotterdam, with a satellite office in Austin, Texas.
